mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, with a t-test p-value > 0.05 against the null of zero mean return.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 9.5% over three consecutive months indicates improving labor market conditions, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where UNRATE < 9.5% for 3 consecutive months, with a t-test p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential construction permits (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong underlying demand growth, which enhances corporate revenue visibility and supports equity market performance over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC drops below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 with a 3-month consecutive drop indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative during INDPRO < 90.0 for 3 consecutive months, with a t-test p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stagnant FEDFUNDS rate, signals inflationary pressure that may prompt future rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.5%, with a t-test p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) following a prior decline, combined with rising housing starts (HOUST), indicates a recovery in aggregate demand, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 0.5% MoM after 2 consecutive MoM declines and HOUST > 680.0
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in triggered instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 150k and a decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 9.6% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS > 150k and UNRATE < 9.6%, with a t-test p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) at a quarterly rate above 3.0%, combined with stable inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0% YoY), indicates a healthy economic expansion without overheating, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered periods, or the Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.
